summary: Tavia Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (units TAVIU, ordinary shares TAVI, rights TAVIR), filed an 8-K reporting a sponsor handover. Under a September 29, 2026 Purchase and Sponsor Handover Agreement, Fog Cutter Holdings LLC (New Sponsor) acquired 2,243,333 ordinary shares and 249,107 private units from Tavia Sponsor Pte. Ltd. and assumed the sponsor role; closing occurred October 1, 2026. The board approved. Officers Kanat Mynzhanov and Askar Mametov resigned, with Mametov also leaving the board. Watch for a new initial business combination target and any extension or trust-liquidation risk.
